from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyAdministrativeExpense(BaseModel):
    """Administrative expense data reported in one company's filing."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The registrant's legal name")
    expense_type: str | None = Field(description="The line-item label for the expense (e.g., 'General and administrative expenses', 'Operating costs')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported expense amount")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="How the amount is expressed: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions'")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period for this expense")
    note: str | None = Field(description="Any additional context (e.g., related party fees in a note)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_admin_expenses: list[CompanyAdministrativeExpense]
